name: New York University
summary: New York City campuses in Greenwich Village and Brooklyn: 270+ areas of study in 11 schools and colleges; 22% of students come from outside the US.

ib.text: No IB points minimum is published. Finishing the IB Diploma qualifies you to apply as an international applicant; if results are not out, your school sends predicted scores and official results follow.

programmes.name: Business and Political Economy
programmes.about: A Stern degree that combines business and political economy coursework with two required semesters of study away: sophomore fall in London and junior spring in Shanghai.
programmes.selectionNote: You choose Stern's Business Core, Business and Political Economy or Business, Technology and Entrepreneurship on the Common App; places are decided by the whole file.

flagshipSource.title: NYU Stern: Business and Political Economy, with study away in London and Shanghai

faculties.name: College of Arts & Science
faculties.line: NYU's largest undergraduate college: liberal arts and pre-professional study in 90 areas; you choose a major on the application.

faculties.name: Tisch School of the Arts
faculties.line: Most programmes need an audition or creative portfolio on top of the Common App; SAT or ACT scores are optional for these applicants.

faculties.name: Leonard N. Stern School of Business
faculties.line: Pick Business Core, Business and Political Economy, or Business, Technology and Entrepreneurship on the application.

faculties.name: School of Professional Studies
faculties.line: BS degrees in Hospitality, Sport Management and Real Estate, applied for through the Common App.

notes: NYU says its Early Decision agreement is binding: if admitted, you withdraw all other applications.
Estimated 2026-27 tuition and fees are $68,576 in the College of Arts & Science and $70,464 at Stern; the College of Arts & Science total cost of attendance is $100,998.
Admitted international students must show proof of funding for four years of study before a student visa can be issued.
